resources.string: Lets Playtest Demon use the volume buttons while you play: Vol + saves your configured lookback (0–30 seconds) and keeps recording, Vol + again stops and saves the clip, Vol − while recording throws it away. In Record & share mode, clips stay on the phone for sharing later. In Sync to my Mac mode, they go to your paired laptop. Only active during a Playtest Demon session; otherwise the buttons work as normal. It reads nothing on screen except which app is open, to name the clip.
